notes.title: Hail Britannia Final Patch
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
- Two new Global Events have been added: "CCF Victory In Saskatchewan" and "Leduc Oil Strike".
- A Campaign Overview is viewable after completing the game. You will be able to see how characters ended up based on your decisions, as well as your influences with the factions.

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
- Dialogue options now show how a character's opinion of you will change.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- You can no longer load empty save slots.
- The correct ending now plays if the player is unsuccessful convincing Rick to free Maria and Maria has a positive opinion of the player.

This will be the last patch to the game. This is one of my free time passion projects. Thank you to those who have played my first Steam game! I hope you enjoyed!

notes.title: Hail Britannia Patch 2
notes.content:
New Content:
- A new Global Event has been added: "A King Without A Crown"

Quality of Life:
- Added confirmation checks when quitting or returning to the Main Menu.
- Changed the message displayed in combat when trying to use the cover or heal action twice in a turn.
- Spaced out the list of combat buffs for better readability.


Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where portraits would flash when the same character is talking during dialogue.
- Credits text color is now black.

notes.title: Hail Britannia Patch 1
notes.content:
[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
- Cooldown indicators have been added to abilities in combat.
- All text in the game is now black for better contrast, with a few exceptions.
- Global Events now show how decisions change your influence with Canada-Exile and Capitalist-Communist.
- Companion Soldiers now have random names at the beginning of a battle.


[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
- Morale Crusher buff now gives +2 damage, +1 defense, +2 heal, +1 cover (instead of +5 damage, +5 defense, +2 heal, +3 cover)(characters saved with the old buff will keep the old values).
- Combat Medic damage increased to 3 (instead of 2)(characters saved with the old value will keep the old values).
- Anti-Communist By Heart buff now gives +1 defense (instead of 4)(characters saved with the old value will keep the old values).
- Tank Driver damage decreased to 6 (instead of 10)(characters saved with the old value will keep the old values).
- The Adrenaline ability now does 10 damage (instead of 15).
- The Focused Shot ability now does 8 damage (instead of 9).
- The Suppressive Fire ability now does 4 damage and 3 cover (instead of 5 damage and 5 cover).
- Nearly all battles have been adjusted to be more difficult.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Various grammar errors fixed.
- Fixed a bug where an extra space was added after each dialogue line while in a conversation.
- Fixed a bug where enemy health could go below zero when hit with a ability.
- Fixed a bug where the "enemy is killed" message wouldn't show up when killed by a ability.
- Fixed a bug where the player would have to perform another action to progress a battle if the enemy was killed by a ability.
- Combat Medic's Smoke Grenades now works properly.
- Tank Driver's Repair ability now works properly.
- Fixed a rare bug where the "Continue" button during combat could become misaligned
- Fixed a bug where loading a Foot Soldier or Tank Driver save after playing as a Combat Medic would make the enemies attack the medic's Companion Soldiers.
- Fixed a bug where enemy health could go below zero if killed by Companion Soldiers.
- Fixed a bug where Companion Soldiers health could go below zero if killed by the enemy.
- Fixed a bug where the Player's health could go below zero if killed by the enemy.
- Fixed a bug where buffed cover was added to the target's defense despite not taking cover.
- Fixed a bug where buffed healing wasn't applied to the Heal Ally ability.
- Fixed a bug where the displayed amount healed was higher than max healthpoints.

notes.title: Hail Britannia Hotfix 1
notes.content:
- Fixed a small bug relating to loading save files in a different play session
- Fixed a small bug where the save/load menu would show up blank
